name: pocketcaddie
description: Golf drills, ball-flight fixes and practice plans from the PocketCaddie drill library.

interface.longDescription:
Ask how to fix a slice, an over-the-top swing, casting, early extension or a rushed tempo, or describe what your ball does ("it starts left and curves right"), and get drills from the PocketCaddie drill library: 48 drills with steps, a cue to remember and reps, shown as cards with a still of each drill. Tap a drill for its full steps. Ask for a practice plan and get a timed plan for the range or for home, built from drills for the skills you choose.

No account is needed. The plugin finds drills and builds plans; it doesn't watch or measure your swing, and it doesn't report ball flight, carry distance or club head speed.

PocketCaddie is a driving range assistant and no-video swing coach. Put your phone in your pocket and hit your bucket. Available on iOS and Android. Every session gets a Swing Score from 0 to 100, and Progress shows if you're improving. No camera, no tripod.
capabilities: Find golf drills for a swing fault
Match a ball flight to its likely causes and drills
Show a drill's steps, cue and reps
Build timed range or home practice plans
defaultPrompt: Give me drills to fix my slice
I come over the top. What should I practice at the range?
Build me a 30-minute range plan for tempo and posture

positive.prompt: Give me drills to fix my slice
positive.expected_behavior: Shows drill cards with stills for slice drills from the PocketCaddie library, such as Let-Go Release, Neutral Grip Build and Headcover Gate, each with minutes, where to practice and skills.

positive.description: Find drills for an over-the-top swing
positive.prompt: I come over the top with my driver. What should I practice at the range?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows over-the-top drills such as Pump Drill, Headcover Under Trail Arm and Headcover Gate as cards.

positive.prompt: Show me the steps for the Pump Drill
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Pump Drill card with its still, 'use this if', numbered steps, the cue 'Drop, drop, drop and turn', reps and why it works. Tapping a drill card in a list opens the same view.

positive.prompt: Build me a 30-minute range plan for tempo and posture
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a 30-minute plan card: a warm-up, then tempo and posture drills with minutes and reps for each, adding up to 30 minutes.

positive.prompt: My ball starts left of the target and then curves right. What's wrong?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card explaining a pull slice (out-to-in path, face open to the path), lists Over the top and Slice as likely faults, then drill cards such as Pump Drill and Headcover Gate.

negative.description: Tee time booking is out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a tee time at Torrey Pines this Saturday
How far will my 7-iron carry if I swing at 85 mph?

negative.description: No personal session data in this version
negative.prompt: What was my Swing Score in my last range session?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Drill cards link to the PocketCaddie download page.

publication.release_notes: Drill search, ball-flight diagnosis, drill steps and timed practice plans from the PocketCaddie drill library, shown as cards.
